name: Light Switch
summary: Wall rocker light switch plate, on or off; anim toggle flips it for lighting scenes.

params.name: y
params.note: wall item: centred on y (default 760), no ground shadow

params.name: s
params.note: scale; at s = 1 the item is hero size (about 300 px across); use about 0.5 for a real-scale wall

params.name: variant
params.note: on = top of the rocker pressed in; off = bottom pressed in

params.name: anim
params.note: toggle = the switch flips between on and off

author: krakujs
